status: frozen locally after development and before validation; no external preregistration
purpose: Evaluate a capacity-aware decision gate using observable queues and completed flow, against unchanged ABC, persistent backlog guard and fixed allocation, only in synthetic fluid-queue experiments
action_space: same original zero-sum ABC catalog for every adaptive policy; hold is always allowed

development.scope: implementation debugging and documented design choices; not confirmatory evidence

validation.scope: fresh generator seeds unseen during development; same prespecified synthetic families; not external real-world data

legacy_families.source: data/load_test_summary_per_minute.csv, original synthetic requests including retries and bots
legacy_families.generator: simulation.scenarios unchanged, with fresh split seeds

generated_families.source: independently specified synthetic arrivals; does not use the source CSV
generated_families.rng: numpy default_rng SeedSequence([20261125, generated_group_index, scenario_seed, stream]); stream 0 arrivals, stream 1 productivity
generated_families.arrivals: Poisson of piecewise/sinusoidal demand * Uniform(0.9,1.1) episode scale * independent LogNormal(-0.5*0.08^2,0.08) minute factor; phase Uniform(0,2*pi)
generated_families.fault_factor: Uniform(0.42,0.62) per episode for specified abrupt faults

groups.generated_underload: demand 4800+1400*sin(2*pi*t/31+phase), zero demand [64,72); stage-1 productivity multiplied by 0.75 in [24,44). Tests censored-throughput inference and avoiding unnecessary moves.
groups.generated_sustained_processing_fault: demand 10500, 4500 before minute 12 and 5500 from minute 72; stage-1 productivity multiplied by fault_factor in [16,64).
groups.generated_switching_fault: demand 10000+1500*sin(2*pi*t/37+phase), 4000 before minute 10 and 5000 from minute 80; fault_factor applied to stage 0 [14,31), stage 2 [31,39), stage 1 [39,59), stage 0 [59,71).
groups.generated_pulsed_short_fault: base demand 4500; pulses (start,length,height): (12,5,23500),(31,3,28000),(51,7,20500),(74,4,25000). Three-minute faults at stage/start (1,13),(0,32),(2,53),(1,75); each is shorter than dwell.
groups.generated_asymmetric_recovery: base demand 9500, 4500 before minute 12 and from minute 80; base productivity multipliers [1.35,0.72,1.18]; stage 2 additional multiplier 0.58 in [20,48); stage 1 additional multiplier 1.55 in [48,72).
groups.generated_sustained_overload: demand 18000+1200*sin(2*pi*t/29+phase), 5000 before minute 10 and 6000 from minute 80; stage 2 multiplier 0.75 in [32,56).

policy_information_boundary: Current arrivals/current queue and past observed service flow, queue and allocation only; no current or future latent productivity or future arrivals may enter a controller. Scenario arrays and metadata are environment/verification evidence only.
primary_metric: Mean total unfinished work at end of each minute, over the scenario horizon
weighting: For each scenario, average three draws for each stochastic policy. Then equally weight scenario cases, with equal case counts per family. The combined statistic includes both 60-minute legacy and 96-minute generated episodes; report source slices and every group separately.
primary_comparison: capacity_aware versus static: positive lower endpoint of paired95% CI for absolute mean-backlog improvement on the complete validation mixture. This is a conditional synthetic comparison.
ablation: abc_capacity gates only original ABC proposals; capacity_aware ranks the same legal action catalog with a capacity model. Distinguish gating benefits from changing candidate selection.

uncertainty.method: 2000 paired percentile bootstrap replicates, resampling scenario cases within each family; keep all policies paired and average stochastic policy draws first
uncertainty.relative_effect: 100*(mean baseline - mean candidate)/mean baseline; null for zero baseline, absolute difference remains defined
uncertainty.scope: Monte Carlo variability within specified synthetic families; not epistemic/model uncertainty, deployment performance or family-selection uncertainty
uncertainty.multiplicity: Unadjusted exploratory intervals for secondary comparisons; only the predeclared primary comparison can support the corresponding primary statement

integrity: Every simulation checks work conservation, resource conservation, catalog membership, nonnegative allocations, warmup and dwell. Independent replay and observation-boundary checks are specified by root. Source files and final protocol hashes must be verified before validation.
limitations: No real traffic, service telemetry, per-request latency, finite buffers, request errors, resource-transition cost or deployment is modeled.
Three-stage same-minute fluid flow and nominal 200 work units per minute per resource remain assumptions.
New generated arrival families broaden synthetic stress coverage but share the same simulator and queue mechanics.
Fresh seeds do not establish external validity. No guarantee that a gate that wins overall avoids harm in every family.
Development and validation results must be reported separately; validation must not be tuned after inspection.

controller_modes.abc_capacity: Deep-copy unchanged ABC, evaluate only its one proposed legal action against hold, commit the copied core only if accepted.
controller_modes.capacity_aware: A separate deterministic selector ranks every feasible original-catalog action against hold. It does not call ABC to choose its action.

capacity_estimation: Only past allocated resources, processed flow and end queues. Positive end queue reveals a saturated rate; unsaturated service per resource is a lower bound. Explicit 10% reversion toward nominal200 is a prior assumption, not measured recovery.
prediction: Eight-minute constant-action full-path fluid replay; nine fixed models combine demand multipliers0.8/1/1.2 with lower rate0.85*estimate, point estimate, and linear recovery to nominal200. Mean predicted end backlog plus0.25*terminal backlog. Current arrival is already in observed queue; future demand is last3 observed arrivals mean.
acceptance: Mean predicted gain greater than max(10 work units,2% of mean hold cost) AND no model predicts a regression, within1e-7. Hold wins ties; subsequent ties prefer lower transferred volume then action ID.
extra_reserve: Both new policies require >=10 resource units at every stage. Original baselines retain their original nonnegative-only constraint. All actual nonzero transfers come from the same catalog; reserve is an additional conservative restriction.

advancement_criterion.effect: Positive lower95% paired-CI bound against BOTH static and abc_guard, separately in legacy_flash and generated_synthetic slices.
advancement_criterion.constraints: All work/resource/catalog/warmup/dwell checks pass; all generated_underload capacity_aware cases make zero moves and leave zero backlog.
advancement_criterion.meaning: Passing supports broader synthetic testing only, not deployment readiness, formal safety, or optimality.

representative_traces: First scenario seed in each of11 groups; first policy seed for stochastic policies, all6 policies:66 complete traces, chosen before outcomes. All episodes have inline invariants and row accounting. These66 traces also get independent scalar replay.
workflow: Actual NeuronFlow0.1.0, six policy evaluation agents, three workers, comparison join, first-attempt abc_capacity transient exception before simulation, restart/duplicate reuse, and deliberate corrupted static output rejected with dependent blocked and independent branch successful.
no_tuning_rule: No policy/configuration/generator changes after validation outcomes. Any subsequent change requires a new experiment/version and new validation design.
development_choice_log: One smoke case, unit checks, and a full development split were inspected. The nine-model gate parameters were selected from design reasoning before development; no outcome-based parameter search was performed. Any implementation fixes are recorded in DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md.
